mapper.select: SELECT ts.submission_no, t.task_no, t.title AS taskTitle, t.point_reward, ts.status, ts.created_at FROM task_submission AS ts LEFT JOIN task AS t ON ts.task_id = t.id WHERE ts.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ts.created_at DESC

SELECT ts.submission_no, ts.status, ts.created_at, ts.evidence_text, ts.user_id, t.task_no, t.title AS task_title, t.point_reward, u.username, u.email AS user_email, sr.comment AS review_comment, sr.points_awarded FROM task_submission AS ts LEFT JOIN task AS t ON ts.task_id = t.id LEFT JOIN users AS u ON ts.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN submission_review AS sr ON sr.submission_id = ts.id WHERE ts.submission_no = #{submissionNo}
